data_source: KEIBA LAB timestamped official NAR pre-off odds snapshots from five-minute GitHub capture and one-minute Supabase capture; official final odds are not read.

pre_registered_rule.blend: Fixed 50% model probability + 50% normalized captured-market probability; same odds-covered runners; no holdout tuning.
pre_registered_rule.selection: At most one highest expected-value qualifying win horse per race; otherwise skip; JPY100 diagnostic stake.
pre_registered_rule.thresholds: Fixed before G4 evaluation; no tuning on holdout.

time_bucket_market_movement.note: Odds change is (later captured odds / earlier captured odds - 1); negative means odds shortened. Only horses present in both snapshots are compared.

trio_evaluation.method: Horse-rank 2-4-5 baseline plus saved trio-combination probabilities joined to the exact selected pre-off 3連複 odds. Combo EV is recalculated as saved probability × captured odds. Partial buys of top 3/6/9/12 are compared by probability rank, EV rank, and 50:50 rank fusion; official NAR trio payouts are outcomes only.

interpretation: G4 joins one-minute Supabase odds to the most recent prior model-score snapshot (maximum age 15 minutes) and also retains five-minute combined snapshots. It uses only captured pre-off odds. Results remain exploratory until at least 100 unique holdout races and 100 qualifying value bets are available and the race-level bootstrap 95% ROI lower bound exceeds 100%. The 1-minute collector improves time-bucket coverage; it does not backfill earlier odds.
